title: Service without jargon: explaining without belittling anyone

videos.script: A technician fixes the problem, and then explains it. The explanation is the part the person remembers. {{remember}} Jargon fails in two ways. The person cannot act on it, and they feel small for not understanding. {{fails}} This lesson gives you a shape for any explanation: what happened, what it means for them, and what happens next. {{shape}} It turns four real error messages into sentences a person can use. And it lists the small words that make somebody feel stupid, so you can stop using them. {{words}}
